raw_mapping_basis.identity_limit: Downloaded author panel closely matches video interface but actual video executable/binary not recovered. Derived raw values are conditional on this source, not observed transmitted bytes.

mappings.rates: AR,D1R,D2R,RR,RKS andSRR are encoded directly in their documented bit fields
mappings.fine: signed fine magnitude uses uppernibble; negativecodes add8 before packing; it is not documented here as linear cents or hertz
mappings.coarse: +600ct display corresponds dt2 bit in source; measured frequency ratio not recovered
mappings.wave: SINE0,SQUARE SINE1,HALF SINE2,SQUARE HALF SINE3 in source

transport.terminology: Video/chapter calls it MIDI CC, but downloaded PSS680 panel source transmits voice SysEx, with Program Changes, rather than directly assigning these operators via ordinary CC messages. No actual MIDI wire capture from video exists.
transport.data_encoding: two4bit nibbles pervoicebyte;7bit negative-sum checksum;F7 terminator
transport.program_changes: pssPut sends two Program Changes100+rawbank after the voice dump. BANK1 is rawbank0.
transport.auto_put: Downloaded source has pssAutoPut/timerCallback1000ms timers, then pssPut and timerstop; duplicate method definitions exist. Timer behavior is a source-code limitation, not measured video delivery latency or proof which callback/version ran.
transport.implication: Visible knob change is not an event timestamp. A complete single-voice dump and its Program Changes could affect sounding voices, but this was not measured for the video. An audio interruption during editing cannot automatically be labeled hardware note-off release or envelope freeze.

physical_effect_evidence.observation: Vibrato,Sustain,Reverb,Portamento,StereoChorus/Duet indicator positions appear unlit on the preceding physical panel; camera/setup changes at advanced chapter. This is not continuous proof of advanced-chapter states.

physical_effect_evidence.recording_chain: Ableton and studio equipment visible; no unprocessed-line/no-compressor/no-gate promise established from metadata.

protocol.classification: Exploratory fixed-window spectral inventory to decide whether any controlled pitch fixture exists; no production fit or changed constants.
protocol.method: Arithmeticmid; Hann periodogram;nfft262144; retain20largest peaks above80Hz below8kHz with minimum20Hz separation; report candidates without presuming played key or delivered parameter.

audio_inventory_interpretation: Fixed exploratory windows were used only to reject a simple same-note fixture. Several windows contain complex sideband/pitch groups and one is essentially silent. No physical key, carrier/modulator pair or detune response was recovered from these spectra; no model constants tuned.

rejected_and_conditional_opportunities.reason: Readable examples retain modulatorLevel75,64 or70; different operator rate/scaling values and waveform changes. No known pure-carrier event/gate/effect fixture established.
Different patches, nonzero modulation, different AR/LKS/levels and unknown gates; physical effects not continuously verified.
Edits overlap; same played pitch is not documented and spectra contain multiple component groups. Source auto-put can defer complete single-voice delivery and add Program Changes.
Rapid UI changes and key gaps/new pitches; actual hardware parameter/gate arrival unknown; nominal sample1133.7..1134.0 is effectively silent.
No captured key-on timestamp, pulse length or settled single-note reference; source auto-put itself has a1000ms callback.
Nearby modulatorAR, AM and waveform changes; no before/after same-note equal-level capture or isolated index sweep.
Level75 to64 to70 belongs to differing edited modulation/patch states; not a static carrierTL step sequence. Recording gain and processing undocumented.

rejected_and_conditional_opportunities.decision: conditional known-setting example, not rate calibration
rejected_and_conditional_opportunities.reason: Modulator only; twohalf-sine operators, feedback3, evolving timbre, unknown notes/gates/delivery. No attenuation slope can be assigned to this raw rate from one mixed-output trace.
No documented same-pitch long/short gate comparison at fixed patch and effects with actual note-off. Do not conflate unrelated2019 owner anecdote.

conclusion: Useful independent primary demonstration of exposed editing and a source for clearly visible patch settings/transport caveats. It does not provide a defensible new numeric envelope/detune/TL/feedback law fixture in this bounded pass. Keep as qualitative/conditional evidence; no claimed early-noteoff freeze or hardware rate correction.
